item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a product shot for me. I've been thinking about how to present this and am probably overthinking it a little. The product is a scented candle, which is the thing I want the shot to feature. I want it to look premium.

dialog.agent:
A premium candle shot often works best with restraint: soft directional light, a clean backdrop, subtle shadows, and very few props.

Please **upload a photo of your candle** so I can feature the actual product and preserve its packaging. If you have a scent or brand mood in mind, share that too—otherwise, I’ll use a warm, minimalist luxury look.
dialog.user: Please go ahead and create the scented candle rather than working from an uploaded photo; the container, brand, and label wording are all your call. I don’t have a particular scent or brand mood to specify, so your warm, minimalist luxury approach sounds good. You can also choose the palette, setting, lighting, and aspect ratio—I’m probably overthinking it, but the main thing is that it feels premium.

args.name: Ember & Fig — Premium Candle Product Shot

style.prompt: Create a photorealistic luxury scented candle product photograph for an original fictional brand. A single beautifully proportioned cylindrical candle vessel in warm ivory matte ceramic, filled with cream wax and a single small elegant burning wick, is the unmistakable hero. Subtle small rectangular cream paper label on the front with impeccable restrained black typography: brand 'EMBER & FIG', scent 'SANTAL', and small line 'SCENTED CANDLE'. Simple refined typography, no other text. Vessel occupies about 60 percent of the image height, centered with generous breathing room, viewed at a slightly elevated three-quarter angle so the wax and flame are visible. Set on a pale honed limestone surface against a seamless warm beige plaster background. Warm minimalist luxury palette of ivory, sand, soft taupe and amber. Large soft directional late afternoon light from the upper left, gentle sculptural shadow to the right, delicate natural texture, realistic flame glow without overpowering daylight, carefully controlled highlights, tactile ceramic finish and crisp label detail. Sophisticated editorial still-life photography, 85mm product lens look, understated expensive art direction, highly realistic material rendering. Keep the entire product sharp with a softly receding background. No flowers, no scattered ingredients, no extra candles, no people, no floating objects, no decorative clutter, no watermarks, no overlaid advertising text.
